query: SELECT count(*) AS legacy_resource_audit_rows FROM public.audit_logs WHERE lower(resource_type) IN ('appointment','appointments','survey','surveys','installation','installations','warranty_ticket','warranty_tickets','production_order','production_orders','contract','contracts','payment_transaction','payment_transactions','operations_outbox','finance_summary','finance_summaries','order','orders','price_calculation','price_calculations','pricing_policy','pricing_policies','company_bank_account','company_bank_accounts');
limitation: Count checks named legacy resource types only; free-form metadata, external exports, backups and other labels are not covered.
